request.prompt: A premium brand sonic logo (audio mnemonic) for an Indian education company, like the signature tune at the end of a high-end TV commercial. C major, 84 BPM. Start with a soft felt piano and a celesta playing exactly three bright rising notes, G, C, E, with a hint of a breath between them; the third note is held and blooms into a warm, resolved C major chord with lush strings and a gentle shimmering bell; then a short natural reverb tail into silence. Hopeful, trustworthy, cinematic, clean modern production. Instrumental only. No drums.

headers.access-control-allow-methods: POST, PATCH, OPTIONS, DELETE, GET, PUT
